origin: This repository's own code, and written for one measurement: does the two-turn replay earn its tokens? Every turn after the first asks about something a previous turn read, so a run with the replay can answer from what it already has while a run without it has to read the file again. Turn 5 asks about a file the replay window cannot hold, which is the control: neither setting should help there. Costs about six turns of real work, which is why it is the only example this long.
